2609.28182.title: Finite-Sample Probabilistic Safety Certification for AI-Based Grid-Edge Coordination
2609.28182.paper_summary: Coordinating large population of flexible grid-edge devices can alleviate the need for time-consuming and capital-intensive network upgrades, and AI-based control methods such as multi-agent reinforcement learning or imitation learning are promising in their real-time decision scalability. However, system operators still need an independent and rigorous way to decide whether a given AI system is safe enough for deployment. This paper develops a finite-sample probabilistic safety certification framework for black-box AI decision models in closed-loop grid operation. The central idea is to reduce the complete input--AI--grid evaluator workflow to a binary unsafe outcome under an operator-defined safety specification, and then use exact binomial inference to certify the corresponding unsafe operation probability. Given a set of held-out calibration scenarios, the framework returns the tightest one-sided upper certificate and an accept/reject deployment criterion that controls the probability of false safety certification. Because the certification is for the calibration distribution that may deviate from the future operation, we further combine the nominal certificate with physically interpretable sample-space adversarial attacks, a concept widely used in AI to investigate the fragility of AI models. Case studies on grid-edge flexibility coordination with 1{,}000-agent AI models (independent parameters) verify the finite-sample safety guarantee and the value of integrating adversarial attacks into a rolling-window training-certification-deployment flow.
2609.28182.paper_summary_zh: 協調大量靈活的邊緣設備可以減少耗時且資本密集的網絡升級需求，而基於 AI 的控制方法，如多代理強化學習或模仿學習，在實時決策的可擴展性方面顯示出良好的前景。<lb/>然而，系統運營商仍然需要一種獨立且嚴謹的方法來決定給定的 AI 系統是否足夠安全以進行部署。<lb/>本文為封閉迴路電網操作中的黑箱 AI 決策模型開發了一種有限樣本概率安全認證框架。<lb/>核心思想是將完整的輸入--AI--電網評估工作流程簡化為在運營商定義的安全規範下的二元不安全結果，然後使用精確的二項推斷來認證對應的不安全操作概率。<lb/>給定一組保留的校準場景，該框架返回最緊的單側上界證書和一個接受/拒絕的部署標準，以控制虛假安全認證的概率。<lb/>因為認證是針對可能偏離未來操作的校準分佈，我們進一步將名義證書與物理可解釋的樣本空間對抗攻擊相結合，這是一個在 AI 中廣泛使用的概念，用於研究 AI 模型的脆弱性。<lb/>對於具有 1,000 個代理 AI 模型（獨立參數）的邊緣靈活性協調的案例研究驗證了有限樣本安全保證和將對抗攻擊整合到滾動窗口訓練-認證-部署流程中的價值。
